tableOverrides.name: articles

CREATE TABLE `articles` (

  `positiveInd` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `openedOriginalCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `hotInd` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `hotlinks` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  `imageWidth` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `imageHeight` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `imageMimeType` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `imageSource` enum('media-content','media-thumbnail','enclosure','cleaned-content','content','description','publisher') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `author` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `description` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `descriptionHtml` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `descriptionText` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `contentOriginal` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `contentHtml` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `contentText` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `contentSummaryBullets` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `contentSourceHash` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `isOfficialSource` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `officialOrganization` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `embedding_model` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `articleVector` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `eventId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `language` tinytext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `advertisementScore` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `toneScore` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '50',
  `qualityScore` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '50',
  `interestScore` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `attentionBucket` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `publishedAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `modifiedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `publishedSource` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `publishInferred` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `firstSeen` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `readAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `urlHash` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `duplicateOfArticleId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `duplicateCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `normalizedUrl` varchar(1024) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `normalizedUrlHash` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `contentTextHash` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `aiAnalysisStatus` enum('pending','processing','complete','skipped','failed') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'complete',
  `aiAnalysisCompletedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `advertisementScoreActionOverrideInd` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `qualityScoreActionOverrideInd` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `lastOpenedOriginalAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `savedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `positiveFeedbackAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `negativeFeedbackAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastMeaningfulReadAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `interestScoredAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `aiAnalysisProvenance` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `originalSource` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `authors` json DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `articles_feedId_normalizedUrlHash_unique` (`feedId`,`normalizedUrlHash`),
  UNIQUE KEY `articles_feedId_urlHash_unique` (`feedId`,`urlHash`),
  KEY `articles_feedId_idx` (`feedId`),
  KEY `articles_userId_idx` (`userId`),
  KEY `articles_userId_published_idx` (`userId`,`publishedAt`),
  KEY `articles_status_idx` (`status`),
  KEY `articles_clickedAmount_idx` (`openedOriginalCount`),
  KEY `articles_eventId_idx` (`eventId`),
  KEY `articles_userId_eventId_published_idx` (`userId`,`eventId`,`publishedAt`),
  KEY `articles_userId_status_published_idx` (`userId`,`status`,`publishedAt`),
  KEY `articles_userId_feedId_status_published_idx` (`userId`,`feedId`,`status`,`publishedAt`),
  KEY `articles_userId_feedId_published_idx` (`userId`,`feedId`,`publishedAt`),
  KEY `articles_userId_status_feedId_published_idx` (`userId`,`status`,`feedId`,`publishedAt`),
  KEY `articles_userId_feedId_status_advertisementScore_idx` (`userId`,`feedId`,`status`,`advertisementScore`),
  KEY `articles_userId_feedId_status_sentimentScore_idx` (`userId`,`feedId`,`status`,`toneScore`),
  KEY `articles_userId_feedId_status_qualityScore_idx` (`userId`,`feedId`,`status`,`qualityScore`),
  KEY `articles_feedId_userId_fkey` (`feedId`,`userId`),
  KEY `articles_user_feed_urlhash_crawl_idx` (`userId`,`feedId`,`urlHash`),
  KEY `articles_user_feed_url_crawl_idx` (`userId`,`feedId`,`url`(255)),
  KEY `articles_user_feed_title_crawl_idx` (`userId`,`feedId`,`title`(255)),
  KEY `articles_favoriteInd_idx` (`savedInd`),
  KEY `articles_userId_favoriteInd_published_idx` (`userId`,`savedInd`,`publishedAt`),
  KEY `articles_duplicateOfArticleId_idx` (`duplicateOfArticleId`),
  KEY `articles_userId_duplicateOfArticleId_published_idx` (`userId`,`duplicateOfArticleId`,`publishedAt`),
  KEY `articles_userId_isOfficialSource_published_idx` (`userId`,`isOfficialSource`,`publishedAt`),
  KEY `articles_contentSourceHash_idx` (`contentSourceHash`),
  KEY `articles_userId_contentTextHash_idx` (`userId`,`contentTextHash`),
  KEY `articles_userId_contentSourceHash_idx` (`userId`,`contentSourceHash`),
  KEY `articles_userId_aiAnalysisStatus_idx` (`userId`,`aiAnalysisStatus`),
  KEY `articles_behavior_read_idx` (`userId`,`positiveInd`,`negativeInd`,`savedInd`,`filteredInd`,`duplicateOfArticleId`,`lastMeaningfulReadAt`,`attentionBucket`),
  KEY `articles_user_status_visible_event_idx` (`userId`,`status`,`filteredInd`,`duplicateOfArticleId`,`eventId`,`id`),
  KEY `articles_user_visible_created_idx` (`userId`,`filteredInd`,`duplicateOfArticleId`,`createdAt`),
  FULLTEXT KEY `articles_title_contentText_fulltext_idx` (`title`,`contentText`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
foreignKeys: ALTER TABLE `articles` ADD CONSTRAINT `articles_duplicateOfArticleId_foreign_idx` FOREIGN KEY (`duplicateOfArticleId`) REFERENCES `articles` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE

tableOverrides.name: categories
tableOverrides.create:
CREATE TABLE `categories` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `categoryOrder` int DEFAULT '0',
  `createdAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `iconName` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `clusteringBehavior` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `pinned` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `categories_id_userId_unique` (`id`,`userId`),
  KEY `categories_userId_order_name_idx` (`userId`,`categoryOrder`,`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

tableOverrides.name: crawl_runs
tableOverrides.create:
CREATE TABLE `crawl_runs` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('running','completed','failed') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
  `startedAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `completedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `errorMessage` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `createdAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `newArticles` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `updatedArticles` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `articleErrors` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `errors` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `durationMs` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `processedFeeds` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `failedFeeds` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `timedOutFeeds` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `triggerType` enum('scheduled','api') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `feedsAttempted` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `feedsSucceeded` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `feedsRecovered` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `articlesFetched` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `articlesUnchanged` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `articlesDuplicate` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `heartbeatAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `ownerToken` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `articlesFiltered` int DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `crawl_runs_active_user_unique` (((case when (`status` = _utf8mb4'running') then `userId` else NULL end))),
  KEY `crawl_runs_userId_idx` (`userId`),
  KEY `crawl_runs_userId_startedAt_idx` (`userId`,`startedAt`),
  KEY `crawl_runs_status_heartbeatAt_idx` (`status`,`heartbeatAt`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
foreignKeys: ALTER TABLE `crawl_runs` ADD CONSTRAINT `crawl_runs_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`userId`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE

CREATE TABLE `events` (

tableOverrides.name: feeds
tableOverrides.create:
CREATE TABLE `feeds` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `categoryId` int NOT NULL,
  `feedName` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `feedDesc` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `feedType` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `url` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `favicon` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `errorCount` int DEFAULT '0',
  `errorMessage` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `errorSince` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `mutedUntil` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('active','error','disabled') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `feedTrust` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.75',
  `feedDuplicationRate` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `feedAttentionAvg` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `feedDeepReadRatio` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `feedSkimRatio` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `feedIgnoreRatio` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `feedOpenedOriginalAvg` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `feedOpenedOriginalRatio` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `feedAttentionSampleSize` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `feedAttentionUpdatedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `crawlSince` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastFetched` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `applyAiAnalysis` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `generateEmbeddings` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `feedTags` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `updateIntervalMinutes` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `etag` varchar(2048) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastModified` varchar(1024) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `contentHash` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `cacheFreshUntil` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastAttemptAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastSuccessAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastChangedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastPublishedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `observedEntryIntervalMs` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `consecutiveFailures` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `nextFetchAt` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `lastFetchOutcome` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `leaseUntil` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `leaseOwner` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `publisherSelfUrl` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `publisherSelfStatus` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `publisherSelfCheckedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `publisherSelfDiagnostic` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `lastCrawlAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastCrawlStatus` enum('SUCCESS','RECOVERED','FAILED') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastCrawlErrorCategory` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastCrawlDurationMs` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastSuccessfulCrawlAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `totalCrawlFailures` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `totalCrawlSuccesses` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `itemFilter` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `sourceConfig` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastArticleReceivedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `pinned` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `authenticationType` enum('basic') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `authenticationUsername` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `authenticationPassword` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `sourceAffinity` float DEFAULT NULL,
  `initialImportCompletedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `ongoingAdmissionWindowDays` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '30',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `feeds_id_userId_unique` (`id`,`userId`),
  UNIQUE KEY `feeds_userId_url_unique` (`userId`,`url`),
  KEY `feeds_userId_idx` (`userId`),
  KEY `feeds_userId_feedName_idx` (`userId`,`feedName`),
  KEY `feeds_categoryId_idx` (`categoryId`),
  KEY `feeds_userId_categoryId_idx` (`userId`,`categoryId`),
  KEY `feeds_categoryId_userId_fkey` (`categoryId`,`userId`),
  KEY `feeds_due_claim_idx` (`status`,`nextFetchAt`,`leaseUntil`,`id`),
  KEY `feeds_user_due_claim_idx` (`userId`,`status`,`nextFetchAt`,`leaseUntil`,`id`),
  KEY `feeds_lease_owner_idx` (`leaseOwner`),
  CONSTRAINT `feeds_publisherSelfStatus_check` CHECK ((`publisherSelfStatus` in (_utf8mb4'validated',_utf8mb4'known_alias',_utf8mb4'invalid',_utf8mb4'security_rejected',_utf8mb4'unreachable',_utf8mb4'malformed',_utf8mb4'unrelated')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

tableOverrides.name: user_settings
tableOverrides.create:
CREATE TABLE `user_settings` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `categoryId` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '%',
  `feedId` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '%',

  `sort` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DESC',

  `minToneScore` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `minQualityScore` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `viewMode` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'expanded',
  `grouping` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',
